notable_absence.finding: Pure JS code-sample page: a regex-based email-domain normalizer (e.g. jack.smith@mailhost.company.com -> jack.smith@company.com) run inside OnUpdate. The page's stated goal, "Redact Sensitive Data prior to sharing" (also its front-matter description), is broader than what the code actually does - it normalizes an email domain, it doesn't redact anything. This description/content mismatch is identical on the Capella twin; noting it again here since it's a documentation-accuracy issue independent of which product tree it appears in, but it doesn't rise to a mintable concept or relation.
